issue_context.title: GSM SMS Notify service Unicode data key not respected
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Original issue (ability to send non-Unicode SMS messages) raised as issue [61488](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/61488) and fixed by pull [76834](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/76834), with the changes to the notify service in pull [76733](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/76733).

Unfortunately the unicode data key in the service call [as documented ](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sms/) does not function as expected.

Calling the service as documented targeting a device that does not support unicode with:
```
service: notify.sms
data:
  message: "status request"
  target: "0044nnnnnnnn"
  data:
    unicode: False
```
does not elicit the expected response from the device.

Modifying the relevant code in component notify.py from:
```
smsinfo = {                                                         
            "Class": -1,                                                    
            "Unicode": is_unicode,                                          
            "Entries": [{"ID": "ConcatenatedTextLong", "Buffer": message}], 
        }
```
to 
```
smsinfo = {                                                         
            "Class": -1,                                                    
            "Unicode": False,                                          
            "Entries": [{"ID": "ConcatenatedTextLong", "Buffer": message}], 
        }
```
, restarting the HA Container and executing service call
```
service: notify.sms
data:
  message: "status request"
  target: "0044nnnnnnnn"
```
receives the expected response from the device (indicating that the message was encoded in GSM rather than unicode).

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

code-2022.9.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

SMS notifications via GSM-modem

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sms/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
service: notify.sms
data:
  message: "status request"
  target: "0044nnnnnnnn"
  data:
    unicode: False
```
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_

review_comments: extended_data cant be None here, since you default it to {} so this check is not needed.
If I dont check, the code in line 51 will fail with missing method `get`
extended_data is a always a dict after the get(attr_data, {}). Which you then call get(conf_unicode, True) willl return True if attribute is missing.

The problem is that extended data is `None` so the data is not initialized as dict.
```
2022-09-20 14:50:05.946 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sms.notify] Extended data:None
```

This is what I get after that: 
```
2022-09-20 14:50:05.947 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.helpers.script.websocket_api_script] websocket_api script: Error executing script. Unexpected error for call_service at pos 1: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/oscar/repos/core/homeassistant/helpers/script.py", line 450, in _async_step
    await getattr(self, handler)()
  File "/home/oscar/repos/core/homeassistant/helpers/script.py", line 683, in _async_call_service_step
    await service_task
  File "/home/oscar/repos/core/homeassistant/core.py", line 1738, in async_call
    task.result()
  File "/home/oscar/repos/core/homeassistant/core.py", line 1775, in _execute_service
    await cast(Callable[[ServiceCall], Awaitable[None]], handler.job.target)(
  File "/home/oscar/repos/core/homeassistant/components/notify/legacy.py", line 258, in _async_notify_message_service
    await self.async_send_message(**kwargs)
  File "/home/oscar/repos/core/homeassistant/components/sms/notify.py", line 48, in async_send_message
    is_unicode = extended_data.get(CONF_UNICODE, True)
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get'
```
Okey, seems a strangeness with the service definition then. I suggest you change the get(attr_data, {}) to just get(attr_data) to make it less confusing.
